outcome: relative change in stroke volume index (SVI)
cohort: 51 healthy parturients scheduled for elective cesarean delivery under spinal anesthesia.
finding: A statistically significant decline in stroke volume index (SVI) was observed in the majority of subjects between spinal anesthesia and the onset of first hypotension, suggesting SVI decline as an early indicator of impending hemodynamic compromise.
mod_finding: A marked decline in stroke volume index (SVI) was observed during cesarean delivery under spinal anesthesia, preceding the onset of hypotension.
cross-section timing: Perioperative monitoring during cesarean delivery, conducted between December 2023 and April 2024.
